Create LD-2026-08-18-042 and isolate Phase 2 on feature/geos-phase2-experience-reuse.
Extend the existing path spine with RECEIPT_DIR and add a minimal validated experience projector instead of creating a parallel memory or validation subsystem.
Wire relevant prior experience into the existing deterministic run path and generated directive evidence while keeping execution_authorized false.

Added positive and negative cross-run reuse tests.
Added validation coverage for evidence-backed reused_experience records.

operator_interventions.reason: Approved Phase 1 merge after being told approval would immediately continue into the N+1 reuse directive.
operator_interventions.effect: Phase 1 was merged and bounded Phase 2 implementation proceeded; no Phase 2 merge authority has been granted yet.

review_events.gate: Phase 1 merge and Phase 2 bounded continuation
review_events.rationale: Operator explicitly approved the Phase 1 merge after the continuation path to N+1 was stated.
Implementation and automated validation are complete, but PR #44 has not received operator merge approval.

friction: A redundant scratch issue #43 was accidentally created during Phase 2 routing and immediately closed as not planned; #42 remains the single source of truth.

The existing CI workflow name still says GEOS Phase 1 Contract even though its full regression suite correctly validates Phase 2; renaming the protected workflow was intentionally avoided to prevent unnecessary scope and review overhead.

reusable_learnings.learning: Cross-run reuse can be added as a deterministic projection over validated receipts without creating a separate memory service, validator, or authority plane.
Historical experience reuse requires an explicit time cutoff and relevance boundary; otherwise replay can leak future knowledge or unrelated context into a run.
Repository tracking should preserve one canonical directive issue per bounded increment; redundant scratch records add navigation cost without adding decision value.

reused_experience.statement: Graph Engineering OS should extend the existing Leverage Engine contracts and validation spine rather than create parallel backend/control infrastructure.
reused_experience.application: Phase 2 inspected and extended paths.py, runner.py, the existing execution-receipt schema, and the existing schema validator contract instead of introducing a new memory database, validator, or authority engine.
reused_experience.observed_effect: The N+1 capability was implemented in seven bounded files with no protected workflow change; DiffWall routed the PR ALLOW at 3/100 risk.

reused_experience.statement: A proposed improvement is not admissible to the compounding loop unless its supporting evidence references are non-empty and retained learnings should meet the same standard.
reused_experience.application: The new reused_experience receipt record requires non-empty supporting evidence and has positive/negative schema tests.
reused_experience.observed_effect: Unsupported reuse claims are rejected by the same canonical receipt contract used for retained execution history.

reused_experience.statement: Make the next Leverage Engine repository run ingest relevant prior execution receipts and reusable learnings as explicit context, then prove Run N+1 used LE-EXEC-2026-0001.
reused_experience.application: The experience-reuse-valid fixture requests Phase 1 scopes/project identity; run_fixture loads the retained receipt, projects relevant experience, and adds experience:LE-EXEC-2026-0001 to both run evidence and generated directive evidence.
reused_experience.observed_effect: The N+1 fixture and full regression suite passed, while negative tests exclude unrelated scope, future receipts, and prior authority state.

residual_risks: PR #44 is validated but not merged, so Phase 2 remains partial.
Experience relevance is currently deterministic exact scope/project matching; supersession, contradiction resolution, and context-budget limits are not yet implemented.
Graph Engineering OS still does not render or query these receipts directly in its browser interface.
The experience projector is suitable for the bounded proof but has not yet been validated across multiple heterogeneous repositories or large receipt histories.
gate_reasons: Phase 2 implementation and automated validation pass
DiffWall route is ALLOW at 3/100 risk
operator merge approval for PR #44 remains required

next_improvement.objective: After Phase 2 merge, define Context Compiler v0.1 with supersession/contradiction handling and a bounded context budget before broadening receipt reuse across the ecosystem.
next_improvement.rationale: N+1 proves that retained experience can alter a later execution; the next compounding constraint is selecting only current, non-contradicted, task-relevant experience without unbounded context growth.
